course: Trigonométrie — αβγ / Тригонометрия / 三角函数
description: Build the unit circle, define sine and cosine, and verify key identities. All commands are 2D — avoids functions, matrices, and 3D planes (BUG-014 safe).
author: GeoGebraPlus Course Team

tree.title: 1. Le cercle unité (é è à ç ù œ « »)
tree.description: Construct the unit circle and a moving point on it.

children.title: 1.1 Origine O — point d’origine
children.description: Place a point at the origin and name it O.

actions.description: Create point O at the origin.

children.title: 1.2 Тригонометрия: окружность
children.description: Draw a circle with center O and radius 1.

children.title: 1.3 Ελληνικά: α β γ δ θ π
children.description: Create a point P on the unit circle. You can drag it later.

actions.description: Create point P on circle c.

children.title: 1.4 数学 三角函数 半径
children.description: Connect O to P to visualize the radius.

actions.description: Draw segment from O to P.

tree.title: 2. Maths: √2 ≤ π ≥ ∑ ∞ ∫ → ± ½
tree.description: Define the angle alpha and project P onto the axes.

children.title: 2.1 Emoji 📐 ✓ (fallback)
children.description: Place a fixed point A at (1, 0) on the circle.

children.title: 2.2 Ünïcödé Ñ ß Ø Å
children.description: Measure the angle from A to P around O.

children.title: 2.3 Project P onto the x-axis
children.description: Drop a perpendicular from P to the x-axis to find cos(alpha).

children.title: 2.4 Project P onto the y-axis
children.description: Drop a perpendicular from P to the y-axis to find sin(alpha).

tree.title: 3. Sine and Cosine Values
tree.description: Read the coordinates of P and verify they match sin and cos.

children.title: 3.1 Display cos(alpha)
children.description: The x-coordinate of P is cos(alpha).

actions.description: Read the x-coordinate of P (should equal cos(alpha)).

children.title: 3.2 Display sin(alpha)
children.description: The y-coordinate of P is sin(alpha).

actions.description: Read the y-coordinate of P (should equal sin(alpha)).

children.title: 3.3 Verify: cos^2 + sin^2 = 1
children.description: Check the fundamental identity using CAS.

actions.description: CAS simplification of the Pythagorean identity.

feedback.pass: Correct! The Pythagorean identity holds: cos²(x) + sin²(x) = 1.
feedback.fail: Something went wrong. The CAS should simplify this to 1.

tree.title: 4. Special Angles
tree.description: Set P to known positions and verify exact values.

children.title: 4.1 Set alpha = 30 degrees
children.description: Move P so the angle is 30° and check cos and sin.

actions.description: Create point at 30° on the unit circle.

children.title: 4.2 Set alpha = 45 degrees
children.description: Move P so the angle is 45° — sin and cos should be equal.

actions.description: Create point at 45° on the unit circle.

children.title: 4.3 Set alpha = 60 degrees
children.description: Place a point at 60° and verify sin(60°) = √3/2.

actions.description: Create point at 60° on the unit circle.

tree.title: 5. Double Angle Formula
tree.description: Verify sin(2x) = 2 sin(x) cos(x) using CAS.

children.title: 5.1 Expand sin(2x)
children.description: Use the CAS to expand the double angle formula.

feedback.fail: The CAS should return 2 cos(x) sin(x).

children.title: 5.2 Verify cos(2x)
